reviews.text: Bird Sounds Identifier Call ID. This is for an experienced birder or someone that wants to become one. I was under the impression that after I recorded all of these various birds singing & chirping right outside my window, this app would identify each bird by their lovely songs and then I’d be able to use of those as ringtones. If I can get my money back that would be my goal, but this is a lovely concept - just not the one I was looking for.
